reply:
Hi,

To send a newsletter to your members, go to **Emails → Send Newsletter** and click **New Email Newsletter**. Name the campaign and pick a starting option (from scratch, AI‑generated, or a template). In the editor that opens, you’ll see four sections: Edit Email, Preview Email, Select Recipients, and Schedule Email. Design and preview your message, choose the recipients (your members), then set a send time. Once scheduled, the campaign will appear in **Emails → Send Newsletter** with a Draft status until it is sent.

Let me know if you need any further help!

reply: You can connect a payment gateway by navigating to Finance ► Payment Settings in the admin panel. If you don’t already have an account with a gateway, create one (Stripe is recommended for best results). Then click "Add New Payment Gateway" and select your chosen provider from the drop‑down list. Once activated, funds will be deposited into the account linked to that gateway, in the supported currency and country. Note that switching gateways will not automatically migrate existing subscriptions—you’ll need to delete the old gateways for migration to occur.

reply: You can add member categories manually by going to **My Members → Member Categories** in the admin panel. From there you can create top‑level, sub, and sub‑sub categories. reply: To find a specific member in the admin area, open **Members** in the dashboard and use the search field to enter the member’s name, email, or other criteria. Once the member appears in the list, click the row and select **Actions → Payment History** to view details. If you need the member’s unique ID, follow the instructions for viewing a member’s unique ID number. You can also use URL parameters such as `&parentid=123` for the Parent Member ID or `&userid=` for the User ID directly.

reply: You can add a custom field by cloning the existing signup form and then editing the clone. In the form editor you may add, remove, rename, reorder, or mark fields as required—just avoid deleting required system fields or payment fields (unless you’re adding payment fields to a paid plan). Once you’ve made your changes, save the form. Be sure the form name starts with "Member‑Sign Up" so it appears as an option when assigning it to a membership plan.

reply: To edit the main navigation menu on your Brilliant Directories site, go to **Design Settings → Main Menu Design** and adjust the menu’s style and items there. You can also hide the menu on a specific page via the **Page Details / Page Options** tabs by selecting “Hide Top Header Menu” or “Hide Main Menu.”
